title: Butter Beans and Susie, Pigmeat Markham and the end of the Palace
summary: Howard recalls not working with them and playing for the last shows at the Palace.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: What about Butter Beans and Susie? Did you ever know them?
Butter Beans and Susie? I know them from when the lyrics time I was a kid, then I would tell you, I'd go to the lyrics place to come here. I never know a person. Did you hear Pigmeat Markham? Yeah.
I heard of him. I never met him. You never worked with him.
No. I never worked with him. No. I never worked with him.
I just wanted. No. No. I never worked with him. Bucking Bubbles, would they ever come down? Or people like that, you know? You know Bucking Bubbles, huh? No.
They never came. Never came. At the Palace.
Yeah. I just wondered who they'd have, any of those people. I've seen Pigmeat at the Palace myself.
Well I don't remember playing for him, but he came before my time, or before I was working there. Because I closed, they closed with the water bill there. I played for the last of them.
That's been about eight years ago they brought Pig Meat down or something.
Well they had special shows come in between that time after they closed the regular show, the regular water bill down here.
